_about: Measured 2026-10-09 with composer_probe(type_mention='@<first name>', pick_option=...) on the German interface, anonymised: names, headlines, ids and image URLs are invented placeholders; structure, attributes, roles, classes and wording are as measured. English interface: not measured (the account language was not switched).

member_composer.engine: tiptap (ProseMirror); editor div[contenteditable][role=textbox][componentkey=ShareBox_textEditor], class 'tiptap ProseMirror'; the DOM node carries the tiptap instance as .editor (main world only)

status.text: 13 Vorschläge verfügbar, verwenden Sie zum Navigieren die Auf- und Ab-Pfeiltasten

option.inner: div[role=button][tabindex=-1] > figure[aria-hidden] (svg#person-accent-4 | svg#company-accent-4, img) + p(title) + p(subtitle)

member_composer.option_identity: no DOM attribute; React prop id='mentionTypeahead_display_<entityID>' on the option subtree; entityID = profile id 'ACoAA...' for a person, numeric organisation id for a company
member_composer.loading: the first snapshot (0.3 s) still listed results for a shorter prefix; the list settled by 1.0 s and was identical at 3.5 s

page_composer.engine: Quill; editor div.ql-editor[contenteditable][aria-label='Texteditor zum Erstellen von Inhalten'] plus a hidden div.ql-clipboard[contenteditable] (0x1 px) in the same dialog

status.aria-label: 14 Vorschläge für „Max“ gefunden. Verwenden Sie zum Navigieren die Auf- und Ab-Tasten.

page_composer.status_timing: absent at 0.3 s, present from 1.0 s; it names the query
page_composer.option_identity: none before the click (Ember; no attribute, no framework props)
page_composer.inserted_entity_html: Max Platzhalter

comment_editor.engine: tiptap, same as member_composer; div[contenteditable][role=textbox][aria-label='Texteditor zum Erstellen von Kommentaren'], not inside a dialog
comment_editor.identity_switch: no 'Kommentieren als' / 'Comment as' control on a member's post (measured on a colleague's post); a page's post not measured
